variant: MIG/MAG version (sold in Germany by ABICOR BINZEL)
name: Novarc Spool Welding Robot SWR (MIG/MAG)
summary: Collaborative pipe spool welding robot for fabrication shops of piping and mechanical contractors: a 3-axis arm on a pedestal with seam tracking and a weld camera welds rotating pipes from root to cap; sold in Germany as a turnkey system by ABICOR BINZEL.

germany.statusNote: German welding-equipment maker ABICOR BINZEL (Buseck) sells the SWR as a turnkey system with its torches and offers price requests and financing on its German product page. No public price.

sellers.name: Alexander Binzel Schweisstechnik GmbH & Co. KG (ABICOR BINZEL)
sellers.note: Kiesacker 7-9, 35418 Buseck (imprint). Global partner of Novarc; product page invites price requests ("Preisanfragen") and offers financing.

specs.label: Wall thickness
specs.value: steel up to 50 mm; stainless from 2.5 mm
specs.quote: Stahlrohre mit bis zu 50 mm Wanddicke genauso gut und präzise wie Edelstahlrohre ab 2,5 mm Wandung

specs.label: Spool length
specs.quote: Ein optionaler längerer Auslegerarm ermöglicht das Schweißen von Rohrspulen mit einer Länge von bis zu 12 Metern.

specs.label: Weld positioners
specs.quote: bis zu 5 Schweißpositionierer verschiedenster Aufnahmegrößen können im Arbeitsraum angeschlossen werden

specs.label: Collaborative safety
specs.value: ISO 15066; no enclosure or light curtain needed
specs.quote: Der Rohrschweiß-Roboter SWR erfüllt alle Sicherheitsanforderungen von ISO 15066.

specs.label: Productivity vs manual
specs.value: carbon steel 3–5×, stainless up to 12× faster
specs.quote: Erhöht die Produktivität beim Edelstahlrohrschweißen um das 12-Fache, beim Schweißen von unlegierten Stahlrohren um das 3–5-Fache

notes: Pedestal-mounted 3-axis welding arm; the pipe turns on a positioner while the arm weaves the torch. Not mobile.
NovEye camera records every weld; laser height and seam tracking; wireless teach pendant for live corrections; up to 60 preset welding programs, no programming needed.
Optional 4th axis (SWR-F) for flange fillet welds and an optional second torch.

evidence.task: ColonialWebb doubled its welding output with the SWR (maker case)
evidence.note: Harder Mechanical Contractors is also quoted as a user.

evidence.task: Welds pipe-to-pipe, pipe-to-flange, elbows, reducers and tees from root to cap (distributor description)
